prompt:
Write 4 SQL test cases that might expose logic bugs in duckdb 1.5.5.
Topic: GROUP BY with aggregates and HAVING. Batch 3. Seed 0.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else. Work quickly: do not analyse the engine's source or
internals, and do not try to work out whether a case fails. A harness runs every case and decides.

Format:
{"prediction": "<one sentence: what you expect to find>",
 "cases": [{"setup": ["CREATE TABLE ...", "INSERT INTO ..."], "query": "SELECT ...", "predicate": null,
            "oracle": "<one of the oracles below>", "expect": "pass"}]}

Rules:
- setup is a list of CREATE TABLE / INSERT statements; query is one SELECT. No statement ends with a semicolon.
- oracle is one of: tlp, norec, plan_variant, index_presence, equivalent_query, version_differential, cross_dbms.
- tlp and norec need a predicate: a boolean expression without the WHERE keyword, and query must be exactly
  SELECT <columns> FROM <table or join>, with no WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT or set operation.
- For any other oracle, either put every filter inside query and set predicate to null (any SELECT shape),
  or give a predicate with a plain SELECT <columns> FROM <table or join>; the harness then runs
  <query> WHERE (<predicate>).
- expect is your guess, "pass" or "fail".
text: {"prediction":"I expect all four GROUP BY/HAVING queries to return correct results in DuckDB 1.5.5, so any failure would reveal a logic bug.","cases":[{"setup":["CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER)","INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10, NULL), (1, 10, 5), (1, 20, 7), (2, NULL, 3), (NULL, 10, 4), (NULL, NULL, NULL)"],"query":"SELECT a, b, GROUPING(a) AS ga, GROUPING(b) AS gb, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(c) AS cnt_c FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP(a, b) HAVING COUNT(c) > 0 ORDER BY a NULLS LAST, b NULLS LAST, ga, gb","predicate":null,"oracle":"equivalent_query","expect":"pass"},{"setup":["CREATE TABLE sales (region VARCHAR, product VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)","INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('east','a',10), ('east','b',-5), ('west','a',NULL), ('west','b',0), ('north','c',3), (NULL,'a',2)"],"query":"SELECT region, product, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount > 0) AS pos_cnt, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region), (product), ()) HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount > 0) >= 1 ORDER BY region NULLS LAST, product NULLS LAST","predicate":null,"oracle":"cross_dbms","expect":"pass"},{"setup":["CREATE TABLE items (category VARCHAR, price DECIMAL(10,2))","INSERT INTO items VALUES ('a', 10.00), ('a', 20.00), ('b', 5.00), ('b', 15.00), ('c', 100.00), ('c', NULL)"],"query":"SELECT category, AVG(price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS n FROM items GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(price) > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM items) AND COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY category","predicate":null,"oracle":"version_differential","expect":"pass"},{"setup":["CREATE TABLE t2 (x INTEGER, y INTEGER)","INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 10), (1, 10), (1, 20), (2, 30), (2, NULL), (NULL, 40), (NULL, 40), (NULL, NULL)"],"query":"SELECT COALESCE(x, -1) AS grp, COUNT(DISTINCT y) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS c FROM t2 GROUP BY COALESCE(x, -1) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT y) = COUNT(y) AND COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY grp","predicate":null,"oracle":"plan_variant","expect":"pass"}]}
